session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: Hey Caroline, since we last chatted, I've had a lot of things happening to me. I ran a charity race for mental health last Saturday – it was really rewarding. Really made me think about taking care of our minds.

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: That charity race sounds great, Mel! Making a difference & raising awareness for mental health is super rewarding - I'm really proud of you for taking part!

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: Thanks, Caroline! The event was really thought-provoking. I'm starting to realize that self-care is really important. It's a journey for me, but when I look after myself, I'm able to better look after my family.

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: I totally agree, Melanie. Taking care of ourselves is so important - even if it's not always easy. Great that you're prioritizing self-care.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: Yeah, it's tough. So I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin - which refreshes me and helps me stay present for my fam!

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: That's great, Mel! Taking time for yourself is so important. You're doing an awesome job looking after yourself and your family!

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: Thanks, Caroline. It's still a work in progress, but I'm doing my best. My kids are so excited about summer break! We're thinking about going camping next month. Any fun plans for the summer?

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: Researching adoption agencies — it's been a dream to have a family and give a loving home to kids who need it.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: Wow, Caroline! That's awesome! Taking in kids in need - you're so kind. Your future family is gonna be so lucky to have you!

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.blip_caption: a photography of a sign for a new arrival and an information and domestic building
session_2.text: Thanks, Mel! My goal is to give kids a loving home. I'm truly grateful for all the support I've got from friends and mentors. Now the hard work starts to turn my dream into a reality. And here's one of the adoption agencies I'm looking into. It's a lot to take in, but I'm feeling hopeful and optimistic.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: Wow, that agency looks great! What made you pick it?

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: I chose them 'cause they help LGBTQ+ folks with adoption. Their inclusivity and support really spoke to me.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: That's great, Caroline! Loving the inclusivity and support. Anything you're excited for in the adoption process?

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: I'm thrilled to make a family for kids who need one. It'll be tough as a single parent, but I'm up for the challenge!

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: You're doing something amazing! Creating a family for those kids is so lovely. You'll be an awesome mom! Good luck!

session_2.speaker: Caroline
session_2.text: Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words really mean a lot. I'll do my best to make sure these kids have a safe and loving home.

session_2.speaker: Melanie
session_2.text: No doubts, Caroline. You have such a caring heart - they'll get all the love and stability they need! Excited for this new chapter!

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Hey Mel, what's up? Long time no see! I just contacted my mentor for adoption advice. I'm ready to be a mom and share my love and family. It's a great feeling. Anything new with you? Anything exciting going on?

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you! Wow, what an amazing journey. Congrats!

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Thanks, Melanie! I'm stoked to start this new chapter. It's been a dream to adopt and provide a safe, loving home for kids who need it. Do you have any experience with adoption, or know anyone who's gone through the process?

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: Yeah, a buddy of mine adopted last year. It was a long process, but now they're super happy with their new kid. Makes me feel like maybe I should do it too!

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: That's great news about your friend! It can be tough, but so worth it. It's a great way to add to your family and show your love. If you ever do it, let me know — I'd love to help in any way I can.

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate your help. Got any tips for getting started on it?

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Yep! Do your research and find an adoption agency or lawyer. They'll help with the process and provide all the info. Gather documents like references, financial info and medical checks. Don't forget to prepare emotionally, since the wait can be hard. It's all worth it in the end though.

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: Thanks for the tip, Caroline. Doing research and readying myself emotionally makes sense. I'll do that. BTW, recently I had a setback. Last month I got hurt and had to take a break from pottery, which I use for self-expression and peace.

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Oh man, sorry to hear that, Melanie. I hope you're okay. Pottery's a great way to relax, so it must have been tough taking a break. Need any help?

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: Thanks, Caroline. It was tough, but I'm doing ok. Been reading that book you recommended a while ago and painting to keep busy.

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Cool that you have creative outlets. Got any paintings to show? I'd love to check them out.

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.blip_caption: a photo of a painting of a sunset with a pink sky
session_17.query: landscape painting vibrant purple sunset autumn
session_17.text: Yeah, Here's one I did last week. It's inspired by the sunsets. The colors make me feel calm. What have you been up to lately, artistically?

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Wow Mel, that's stunning! Love the colors and the chilled-out sunset vibe. What made you paint it? I've been trying out abstract stuff recently. It's kinda freeing, just putting my feelings on the canvas without too much of a plan. It's like a cool form of self-expression.

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.blip_caption: a photo of a painting on a wall with a blue background
session_17.text: Thanks, Caroline! I painted it because it was calming. I've done an abstract painting too, take a look! I love how art lets us get our emotions out.

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Wow, that looks great! The blue adds so much to it. What feelings were you hoping to portray?

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: I wanted a peaceful blue streaks to show tranquility. Blue calms me, so I wanted the painting to have a serene vibe while still having lots of vibrant colors.

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.blip_caption: a photo of a poster on a wall in a classroom
session_17.text: Yeah, it's very calming. It's awesome how art can show emotions. By the way, I went to a poetry reading last Fri - it was really powerful! Ever been to one?

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: Nope, never been to something like that. What was it about? What made it so special?

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.blip_caption: a photography of a sign that says trans lives matter
session_17.query: transgender poetry reading trans pride flags
session_17.text: It was a transgender poetry reading where transgender people shared their stories through poetry. It was extra special 'cause it was a safe place for self-expression and it was really empowering to hear others share and celebrate their identities.

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: Wow, sounds amazing! What was the event like? Those posters are great!

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.blip_caption: a photo of a drawing of a woman in a dress
session_17.text: The room was electric with energy and support! The posters were amazing, so much pride and strength! It inspired me to make some art.

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: That's awesome, Caroline! You drew it? What does it mean to you?

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Thanks, Melanie! Yeah, I drew it. It stands for freedom and being real. It's like a nudge to always stay true to myself and embrace my womanhood.

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: I love it. Showing off our true selves is the best thing ever.

session_17.speaker: Caroline
session_17.text: Yep, Melanie! Being ourselves is such a great feeling. It's an ongoing adventure of learning and growing.

session_17.speaker: Melanie
session_17.text: Yep, Caroline. Life's about learning and exploring. Glad we can be on this trip together.

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.blip_caption: a photo of a car dashboard with a white cloth and a steering wheel
session_18.query: car accident damaged car airbags deployed roadtrip
session_18.text: Hey Caroline, that roadtrip this past weekend was insane! We were all freaked when my son got into an accident. We were so lucky he was okay. It was a real scary experience. Thankfully it's over now. What's been up since we last talked?

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Oops, sorry 'bout the accident! Must have been traumatizing for you guys. Thank goodness your son's okay. Life sure can be a roller coaster.

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.text: Yeah, our trip got off to a bad start. I was really scared when we got into the accident. Thankfully, my son's ok and that was a reminder that life is precious and to cherish our family.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Glad your son is okay, Melanie. Life's unpredictable, but moments like these remind us how important our loved ones are. Family's everything.

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.blip_caption: a photo of two children standing on a rocky cliff overlooking a canyon
session_18.text: Yeah, you're right, Caroline. Family's super important to me. Especially after the accident, I've thought a lot about how much I need them. They mean the world to me and I'm so thankful to have them. Thankfully, they enjoyed the Grand Canyon a lot!

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: The kids look so cute, Mel! I bet they bring lots of joy. How did they handle the accident?

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.text: Thanks! They were scared but we reassured them and explained their brother would be OK. They're tough kids.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Kids are amazingly resilient in tough situations. They have an amazing ability to bounce back.

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.text: They're really amazing. Wish I was that resilient too. But they give me the strength to keep going.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Our loved ones give us strength to tackle any challenge - it's amazing!

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.text: Yeah, Caroline. Totally agree. They're my biggest motivation and support.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: It's so sweet to see your love for your family, Melanie. They really are your rock.

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.text: Thanks, Caroline. They're a real support. Appreciate them a lot.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Glad you've got people to lean on, Melanie. It helps during tougher times.

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.blip_caption: a photography of a woman and a child walking on a trail
session_18.text: Yeah for sure. Having my fam around helps a lot. It makes hard times easier.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Wow, great pic! Is that recent? Looks like you all had fun!

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.text: Thanks, Caroline! Yup, we just did it yesterday! The kids loved it and it was a nice way to relax after the road trip.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Glad you got some R&R after the drive. Nature sure seems to refresh us, huh?

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.blip_caption: a photo of a sunset over a body of water
session_18.text: Absolutely! It really helps me reset and recharge. I love camping trips with my fam, 'cause nature brings such peace and serenity.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Wow, that's awesome! What do you love most about camping with your fam?

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.text: It's a chance to be present and together. We bond over stories, campfires and nature. It's so peaceful waking up to the sound of birds and the smell of fresh air - it always refreshes my soul.

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: That's so peaceful and calming, Melanie! I can picture waking up to nature. It's great that you get to spend quality, tranquil time with your family.

session_18.speaker: Melanie
session_18.text: Thanks, Caroline! This is a great time. Nature and quality time, can't beat it!

session_18.speaker: Caroline
session_18.text: Yeah totally! They're priceless. Lucky you!
